title: Dungeon Quest
description: Gear up in a blocky town, then battle through three brick dungeons of zombies, fire imps and yetis. Level up, unlock spin, dash and heal abilities, grab rare to legendary loot, upgrade it at the blacksmith and topple each boss, solo or in online co-op.
controls: WASD move, Space jump, click or F attack, Q/E/R abilities, 1/2 potions, I or Tab inventory, right-drag to turn the camera
